name: com.shanflyer.burstword
description: High-throughput TMP damage text with GPU animation, BRG and automatic instancing fallback. Standard TMP glyph typography without an external shaping library with optional shaping adapters. Unity 2022.3 and newer.

samples.description: Ready-made BRG and pooled TMP scenes (200 emissions/sec), multilingual fonts and four AnimationClip presets. Requires TMP Essential Resources.
